generic_lessons: A collection must be traversed using its actual consumer contract. DONE with zero coverage is not success when the independently known cardinality is nine; a table-port counterexample can reject a candidate without running raw code in the game.
Missing producer and consumer declarations are also an owner packet defect. Record omissions alongside model errors instead of attributing every invented API to the model alone.

Native method qualification is control-specific. A hidden measurement can support a geometry hypothesis, but cannot prove a visible post-animation layout; preserve failed readonly probes and correct owner-invented method names explicitly.

SetHide(inputRequired) means visible when inputRequired is false. Review boolean polarity against the actual consumer before writing documentation or adapting layout; a once-per-instance guard is not responsive reentry handling.

A prose model can copy compressed English notes, reverse chronology or misstate release status despite complete JSON. Verify the writing language, start versus completion times, published version and actual screenshot content, and reject the whole draft when necessary.

An ordinary end action returning is distinct from a turn advancing. Fresh busy checks, zero-input failures, distinct new attempt sequence numbers and readback of actual turns are needed; never replay an unknown click or force a turn.
Zero observer errors and drops only qualify the observer. Twelve request-not-observed warnings remain separate evidence and cannot be relabeled zero gameplay failures.
Reaching ten cities is not a matched performance benchmark. A twenty-turn behavior window without the designed full resource sequence must not silently inherit broader acceptance results.
